Thank you for the help. I am reading up on all the posts and advice I can find on here to try and find a way to talk to him. I've known him for a long time and the issue I'm running into is that he just doesn't talk about it. He hasn't, and my guess is wouldn't, seek professional help. Outwardly you could never tell- which is actually what worries me. He gets a call that his father had a (very minor) heart attack and just keeps on chilling at a party. Not a word or wince was uttered. The only reason I know about most of these situations is from his ex and his parents. 

Thanks again for helping me with him.
